name: NAFNet
license_interpretation: MIT is a permissive license, so these weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products. It asks you to keep the copyright notice and license text with any copy you redistribute, and places no other obligation on your own application code. Part of the training pipeline is ported from BasicSR under Apache-2.0, which additionally grants a patent license. The published checkpoint is trained on the Smartphone Image Denoising Dataset (SIDD), itself MIT-licensed.
